summary: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. filed an 8-K to disclose a joint venture with Mitsubishi HC Capital to form a renewable energy company in Europe. The JV's seed portfolio includes ~570 MW of operating assets valued at ~EUR 400 million equity, highly contracted with ~10-year weighted average PPAs. Brookfield will manage operations; both partners will approve future acquisitions funded pro rata. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided. The filing is a business formation announcement without a transaction classification, thus categorized as Other. Watch for future asset acquisitions and governance updates.
